Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest

Class SerializationGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.SerializationGameTestsLogic
public final class SerializationGameTestsLogic extends Object
Serialization contracts: the flat-JSON eye codecs round-trip by value, and all five native payloads preserve their wire representation through encode/decode. World-less.

  • Method Details

    • networkProtocolIdsAreVersionedAndUnique

      public static void networkProtocolIdsAreVersionedAndUnique(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Every payload id is unique and carries the network version. No in-game form; guards that a client and server with different network versions refuse each other instead of misreading packets.

    • appearanceOverrideSparseNbtRoundTrips

      public static void appearanceOverrideSparseNbtRoundTrips(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Appearance overrides save only the fields that are set, and reject invalid colors. In game: aim at an eyed cow and run /sg admin tint iris 1 0 0; on NeoForge or Forge, /data get entity <cow> shows somegoogly:eyeOverrides in NeoForgeData or ForgeData holding only irisColor, and after save and reload the cow still has red irises.

    • behaviorTriggerPacketRoundTrips

      public static void behaviorTriggerPacketRoundTrips(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The behavior trigger survives the wire. No in-game form; guards that every client sees the expression the server started.

    • configSyncPacketRoundTrips

      public static void configSyncPacketRoundTrips(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The eye-definition sync survives the wire. No in-game form; guards that joining clients draw the same eyes the server's datapacks define.

    • configSyncRejectsOversizedAndUnsafePayloads

      public static void configSyncRejectsOversizedAndUnsafePayloads(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The client refuses an eye-definition sync with too many entries, too many variants, or non-finite geometry. No in-game form with an unmodified server; guards clients against a malicious server.

    • eyeColorRejectsWrongChannelCount

      public static void eyeColorRejectsWrongChannelCount(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      A color must have exactly three channels. In game: a datapack eye definition with "irisColors": [0.5, 0.5] is ignored on /reload, with an error in the log.

    • eyeColorRejectsOutOfRangeChannels

      public static void eyeColorRejectsOutOfRangeChannels(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Both color codecs reject a channel outside 0..1 or non-finite on decode. In-game, /give @s somegoogly:googly_eye[somegoogly:eye_properties={irisColor:[2f,0f,0f]}] fails to parse instead of producing an eye item.

    • eyeDefinitionCodecRoundTripsEveryField

      public static void eyeDefinitionCodecRoundTripsEveryField(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The canonical form is whatever encode produces, so this is the guard that stops a field added to the record from being silently dropped on the way to disk: a value-equal round-trip can only pass if every field was written. DEFAULT would round-trip even with a field elided, so the sample deliberately sets each field away from its default. No in-game form; guards that /sg export writes every eye property an author set.

    • eyeFieldsSerializeAtFloatPrecision

      public static void eyeFieldsSerializeAtFloatPrecision(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Float-precision serialization: a value typed as 0.22 must come back out as 0.22, not as the 0.2199999988079071 a double-widened float prints as. The datapack files are hand-edited, so this is what keeps them readable. In game: give an eye in the picker a position component of 0.22 and run /sg exportall; the exported JSON reads 0.22.

    • pickerExportPacketRoundTrips

      public static void pickerExportPacketRoundTrips(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The picker export request survives the wire, and a request with no definition is refused on decode. No in-game form; guards that /sg export delivers exactly the definition the client authored.

    • pickerFreezePacketRoundTrips

      public static void pickerFreezePacketRoundTrips(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Picker choose and release requests survive the wire. No in-game form; guards that V in the picker freezes and releases the intended mob.

    • eyeStatePacketRoundTrips

      public static void eyeStatePacketRoundTrips(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Entity eye state survives the wire, with and without appearance overrides. No in-game form; guards that every watching client sees a mob's eyes, placement, and colors as the server has them.

    • eyeStatePacketRejectsNonFiniteValues

      public static void eyeStatePacketRejectsNonFiniteValues(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      The client refuses an eye-state packet with a non-finite placement roll. No in-game form with an unmodified server; guards clients against a malicious server.
